[CVPR 2025 Highlight] InterMimic: Towards Universal Whole-Body Control for Physics-Based Human-Object Interactions

InterDiff: Generating 3D Human-Object Interactions with Physics-Informed Diffusion --> InterMimic: Towards Universal Whole-Body Control for Physics-Based Human-Object Interactions Sirui Xu   Hung Yu Ling   Yu-Xiong Wang   Liang-Yan Gui   University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Electronic Arts CVPR 2025 Highlight 🏆 ## 🏠 Overview > **InterMimic** features **one** unified policy, spanning **diverse full-body interactions** with **dynamic, heterogeneous objects**—and it works out-of-the-box for both **SMPL-X** and **Unitree G1** humanoids. ## 📹 Demo ## 🔥 News - **[2026-02-09]** 🚀 Multi-GPU training support is here! - **[2025-12-17]** 🚀 Isaac Gym checkpoints are compatible with IsaacLab inference?! Check out the newly released implementation. - **[2025-12-15]** IsaacLab support is underway! Data replay is ready—more coming in the next release ☕️ - **[2025-12-07]** 🚀 Release a data conversion pipeline for bringing [InterAct](https://github.com/wzyabcas/InterAct) into simulation. The processing code is available in the [InterAct repository](https://github.com/wzyabcas/InterAct). - **[2025-06-10]** Release the instruction for the student policy inference. - **[2025-06-03]** Initial release of PSI and the processed data. Next release: teacher policy inference for [dynamics-aware retargeting](InterAct/OMOMO_retarget), and student policy inference. - **[2025-05-26]** It's been a while! The student policy training pipeline has been released! The PSI and other data construction pipelines will follow soon. - **[2025-04-18]** Release a checkpoint with high‑fidelity physics and enhanced contact precision. - **[2025-04-11]** The training code for teacher policies is live—try training your own policy! - **[2025-04-05]** We're excited by the overwhelming interest in humanoid robot support and are ahead of schedule in open-sourcing our Unitree-G1 integration—starting with a small demo with support for G1 with its original three-finger dexterous hands. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出InterMimic，通过单一统一策略实现全身控制，结合物理信息扩散模型（InterDiff）生成交互数据，并采用教师-学生策略训练，支持SMPL-X和Unitree G1人形机器人的跨实例迁移。


# 一、动机

> 现有物理仿真中的人-物交互控制通常针对单一物体类型或静态场景，难以处理多样、动态、异质物体的全身交互，且不同机器人平台之间缺乏通用性。


# 二、方法

> 提出InterMimic，通过单一统一策略实现全身控制，结合物理信息扩散模型（InterDiff）生成交互数据，并采用教师-学生策略训练，支持SMPL-X和Unitree G1人形机器人的跨实例迁移。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 论文入选CVPR 2025 Highlight，展示了一个统一策略即可覆盖多种全身交互任务，且无需额外调整即可直接部署到SMPL-X和Unitree G1两种不同人形机器人上。


# 四、对我的启发

> 该工作为物理仿真中全身交互控制提供了可跨平台迁移的通用解决方案，但可能依赖大规模高质量交互数据，训练复杂度较高；对于机器人具身智能研究有借鉴意义，尤其是在跨实体迁移和策略蒸馏方面。
